name: Fractal Reflection
description: The Fractal doctrine (fractal-prompt.md and chapters/) that TinkerClaw's background reflection reads after each Tinker turn; the reflection itself runs through the gateway's fractal.gate, the Tinker page and the Tinker bridge, and a guard in the tinkerclaw-core Claude Code plugin turns its sends, deletes, publishes, spends and restarts into proposals. Also carries the legacy triage lane (bible §5.67a/b), OFF BY DEFAULT and billed: with config.enabled true it spawns one read-only triage subagent per finished agent turn, records every decision in an append-only ledger, and runs under a quota governor with a suspend/resume kill switch; findings are only flagged, nothing is edited.

enabled.description: Master opt-in, required IN ADDITION to enabling the plugin entry. Only a literal true arms it. While not true, no agent_end or before_tool_call hook is registered and no triage ever spawns. Turning it on means: one billed subagent run per finished main turn.

triageArm.description: Triage transport arm. NOT IN EFFECT in Drop 1 — only the cold arm (a fresh spawn per turn) is implemented and it is always used; observer and fork-warm are reserved names.

triageThinkLevel.description: Think level for triage-lane spawns. NOT IN EFFECT in Drop 1 — the plugin subagent.run surface has no thinking parameter, so the host default applies; reserved so config written today keeps working.

fixThinkLevel.description: Think level for escalated fix-lane spawns. NOT IN EFFECT in Drop 1 — the fix lane is not implemented yet; this key is reserved so config written today keeps working when it lands.

fixModel.description: Optional model override for fix-lane spawns. NOT IN EFFECT in Drop 1 (no fix lane yet). Default = the parent session's main model. Invalid for models with reasoning:false on thinking arms; fork-warm triage locks model = parent.

laneConcurrency.description: Concurrency for the fractal lanes. NOT IN EFFECT in Drop 1 — concurrency is fixed at one in-flight triage per session (single-flight, latest-wins).

maxFixTurnsCeiling.description: Safety CEILING (design-principle #19) on a fix spawn's --max-turns. NOT IN EFFECT in Drop 1 (no fix lane yet). Exhaustion winds down gracefully (flagged + incomplete:true), never counts toward the circuit breaker.

maxFixSpawnsPerHour.description: Hourly ceiling on fix-lane spawns. NOT IN EFFECT in Drop 1 (no fix lane yet). The triage lane is bounded by a fixed spawn-token bucket of 30 per hour and the circuit breaker.

artifactRoots.description: Extra filesystem roots the fix lane may treat as artifact targets (in addition to runtime defaults in types.ts). NOT IN EFFECT in Drop 1 — no lane writes files today.
